name: ai-proxy
description: Reference local relay and WebMCP library for MCP Pages

scripts.covpages: npm run test:coverage && npx covpages generate --input coverage/lcov.info --output covpages --repo yongjhih/ai-proxy --branch main --title "ai-proxy Coverage" && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs=>fs.writeFileSync('covpages/index.html',fs.readFileSync('covpages/index.html','utf8').replace(/0 8px 24px/g,'0 4px 12px')))"
